rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3AB blastocyst and appropriately notes image limitations, but it overstates confidence in features like absence of debris/degeneration and precise expansion from a single somewhat suboptimal focal plane.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, prior miscarriage, smoking, and endometrial thickness well with embryo quality, though some links are somewhat generic rather than case-specific.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with prognosis modifiers clearly explained; minor tension exists between calling it top-tier and also less advanced than classic expanded morphology.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice, including single embryo transfer in a young patient and standard evaluation after failure/loss; a few suggestions are more discretionary than guideline-driven.
Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, smoking cessation, and targeted workup if failure recurs, though not highly protocol-specific.
